beta_construction: Reuse the fixed seed=6 master profile. For each N, reshape to (N, 4800/N) and take nested block means; the same profile is used at every strength.
cross_size_path_definition: At each of the 13 strengths, retain complete 2x2 cross-size matrices on all three common grids. These matrices are not same-N state tracking.
native_path_definition: For each N and each of the 12 adjacent strength pairs, compare native two-dimensional subspaces after reduced QR. Finite links are not continuous-path proof.
entry_link_definition: For every cross-size matrix entry and adjacent strength pair, compute delta_O_ij, score contribution delta_O_ij/2 and both singular-channel contributions delta_(s_k^2)/2. Dominance is numerical only.
refinement_comparison: Compare the original 9-point/8-link path with the refined 13-point/12-link path for entry extrema, maximum adjacent jumps, driver counts and native-link minima. Do not interpret a smoother sampled curve as convergence proof.
outcome_policy: Retain every preregistered midpoint and link; do not add or remove points after inspecting outcomes, and do not select favorable path segments.
